name: ai.achromat/mcp-server
title: Achromat MOM
description: Recall and calibrate policy-compliant tool-call arguments before execution. Does not run the tool.

environmentVariables.name: ACHROMAT_AGENT_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of the agent's Ed25519 private key (unencrypted PKCS#8 PEM). Created on first use if the file does not exist.

environmentVariables.name: ACHROMAT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Service origin. Must be https (plain http is accepted only for localhost).

environmentVariables.name: ACHROMAT_REF
environmentVariables.description: Optional attribution tag (1 to 32 characters from a-z, 0-9, _ and -) sent as ?ref= on the registration calls only. An invalid tag is ignored.
